newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London down, IBM weak after numbers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London down, IBM weak after numbers.

text.p: U.S. shares were generally lower in Europe on Wednesday, with most high technology issues under pressure following IBM's fourth quarter earnings which were released after Wall Street closed on Tuesday.

The Dow industrials bellweather company reported strong fourth quarter earnings but some analysts were disappointed about sluggish mainframe sales and lower-than-expected restructuring costs, dealers said.
"IBM's earnings were at the top but people are questioning whether or not they can maintain earnings growth," one market maker said.
Elsewhere, Citicorp was down $1/2 at $111-3/4 after the company told analysts some of their assumptions on share repurchases for 1997 may be too agressive.
"The market has been assuming Citicorp would buy back shares at roughly the same level as in previous years but the company is playing down that expectation," one dealer said.
Citicorp has bought back nearly 60 million shares over 1995 and 1996, including 8.1 million in the the fourth quarter of 1996.
The March T-bond was up 4/32 at 111-20/32 while the March S&P 500 futures contract on Globex was up 0.75 at 787.70.
